newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch April manufacturing output up 3.3 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Dutch April manufacturing output up 3.3 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Dutch seasonally adjusted manufacturing production fell 2.8 percent in April 1997 compared with March, the Central Bureau of Statistics (CBS) said.
April manufacturing production was 3.3 percent higher than in the same month of 1996, the CBS added.
DUTCH MANUFACTURING PRODUCTION Apr 97 Mar 97 Apr 96
NOTE - CBS calculates month-on-month changes on basis of seasonally adjusted index and year-on-year changes on basis of non-seasonally adjusted index.
Economists' consensus forecast for April 1997 manufacturing production was a rise of 5.8 per cent year-on-year and a fall of 0.5 percent month-on-month.
CBS said the March manufacturing production had been unusually high, which explains some of the month-on-month drop for April.
